title: More ways to make stories and images
summary:
Four community projects joined the lists: illustrated stories, sketch coloring, historical selfies, and a JSON wrapper.

The Creative Projects list added StoryBolt, which turns prompts into illustrated stories, and Coloring AI, which colors sketches and makes coloring pages from images.

The Games list added Time Travel Selfie Portal. It places portraits in a chosen historical era and generates a humorous biography.

The Creative Projects list added JSON Pollinations API, a Deno Deploy wrapper that returns JSON-formatted responses for apps integrating Pollinations.
